text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, the beach really is the best!
No matter when I come, it always gets my heart racing!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Your driving on the way here had my heart
racing quite a bit as well, Maruzen-san...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the real excitement is just getting started, you know?
There's a place I've been dying to check out lately!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Wow, how lovely! With this classic interior,
it really gives you a sense of history...!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, just as I thought! When I drove past it
earlier, I had a hunch it was super groovy!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Look at this lighting! This glassware technique is
19th-century French antique craftsmanship.
The other furnishings are exquisite too...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's enjoy our day trip to the max today!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
The spa is totally gorgeous and cho-very-good! (choberigu!)
Time to kick back and unwind♪

text_block_list.name: Hotel Staff
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, guests, if you would like,
we would be pleased to offer complimentary drinks for both of you—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how wonderful!
Then I'll have a sparkling water
with a slice of lemon, please~♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Tazuna-san, order something too!
Don't just melt away in the jacuzzi~!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that was thoroughly enjoyable!
I don't eat French cuisine very often,
but I had no idea it could be this delicious!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
From the amuse-bouche to the dessert, it was par-peki (perfect)!
Italian's nice too, but a resort hotel
really ought to be like this!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, garçon, could you tell the chef
that we were completely satisfied with the meal?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~! So wonderful!
Isn't this place just the ultimate resort hotel!

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text:
We are deeply honored by your high praise.
I am the general manager of this establishment.

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text:
By the way... during your stay with us,
were there any points that concerned you?

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text:
...Truly, even the smallest detail would be fine.
Please don't hesitate to share your unreserved opinions.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... Did something happen?
You seem far more troubled than just someone eager at work.
If there's a reason, won't you tell us?

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text:
! ...It is quite shameful to admit.
The truth is—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: What, on the verge of closing down...?

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text:
Yes, recently guests have drifted away to newer facilities
nearby, leaving us operating in the red continuously.
If things continue like this...

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text: Therefore, we are planning a major renewal opening...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
And so you're asking around for areas to improve,
groping around for renewal ideas, right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Areas to improve... points to fix... hmm.
I'm sorry, I'd love to help, but...
it's such a wonderful place that nothing comes to mind.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... But I can't just overlook this situation.
To think a place where you all work with pride
might vanish into thin air.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Hey! How about this?
I'll help out with the renewal too!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
For example—
I could become your PR ambassador!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I might not look it, but I have a pretty wide network!
I'm sure I can spread the word about this place to all kinds of people♪

text_block_list.name: Manager
text_block_list.text:
W-What, are you truly willing to do that...!?
...Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while walking through the academy—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
'Seaside resort, premonition of love—'
Hmm, it needs a bit more trendy flair.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen-san became the PR ambassador for a resort hotel!
As a first step, she seems to be writing the lyrics for its theme song—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
'Seaside resort, romantically in love'
Yes, that's the opening phrase!
At this rate, I'll breeze through writing these lyrics full speed~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the song Maruzensky wrote lyrics for
became a hit topic across the academy for being 'addictive',
boosting the resort hotel's recognition significantly.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Alright! At times like this, a drive is the best breather♪
Tazuna-san has work, so... how about you?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Alright! At times like this, a drive is the best breather♪
Tazuna-san has work, so... how about you?
